title: Analytical Reasoning & Basic Math
summary: Series, percentages, ratio, speed/time, work, clocks, calendars, coding, relations, directions, syllogisms. Fast methods win time for Electrical questions.
facts: Common series: n², n³, n(n + 1), ×2 + 1, primes, Fibonacci.
Syllogism: 'All A are B' gives 'Some B are A', never 'All B are A'.
traps: Average speed over equal distances is NOT the arithmetic mean.
Percentage increase is on the OLD value.
